summary_1line: Sanjaya recounts Arjuna’s fierce message to Duryodhana, warning that the Pandavas and Krishna will annihilate the Kaurava army if the kingdom is not returned.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands on his golden chariot with the ape-banner while Krishna holds the reins, as he vows destruction of the Kaurava host.
Bhima, mace raised, charges like a lion through ranks of warriors and elephants, bodies and shattered chariots strewn across the battlefield.
A storm of arrows pours from Arjuna’s Gandiva, darkening the sky and felling elephants, horses, and chariots across the battlefield.
